description: This file contains implementation of basic functions and API for sparse tensors in PyTorch, including creation, reshaping, coalescing, and viewing as real/complex for sparse tensors. It manages sparse tensor operations such as coalescing and masking, using COO format, and includes internal helper functions for managing sparse tensor data.
